risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (AR-M201 vs other Sharp AR models) can change value and parts availability.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label (usually rear/side/bottom) showing 'AR-M201' and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-matching comparable in the list (worst case for model certainty).

risks.risk: “Fully functional” not proven—could have intermittent faults (scanner, fuser, feed rollers, sensors).
risks.proof: Video/clip of a full cycle: load paper → copy/print → output pages with no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case), using the cheapest comparable.

risks.risk: Page count claim not verifiable; high usage reduces remaining life (especially fuser/drum).
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s counter/page count screen (or service menu) showing total copies.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher usage (worst case), not benefiting from the 'under 20,000' claim.

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may be unverified or low-quality; could still produce poor prints or soon fail.
risks.proof: A close-up of the drum/toner part numbers (if visible) plus a test print showing clean text/low background.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown consumables (worst case), not assuming new parts.

risks.risk: Paper jam-free claim not proven; feed/paper path issues may appear under load.
risks.proof: Clip showing continuous feeding (e.g., 10–20 pages) with no jam and correct output stacking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential feed/paper-path issues (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial label showing the exact model (AR-M201) and serial number.
Photo of the machine’s total counter/page count screen (showing under/over 20,000).
Video test: print/copy at least 10 pages with no error codes and no paper jam.
Close-up photos of the installed drum and toner (and any visible part numbers/labels).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Sharp all-in-one copier, but the exact model (AR-M201) and the key value drivers (page count, working status, drum/toner freshness, jam-free performance) are not verifiable from the provided images.
